title: Orrery model v1
description: An architecture model: components, the connections between them, the groups they sit in, plus views (drawings) and scenarios (what-ifs, in the author's words) over that model. Specification: docs/MODEL.md.

$schema.description: Schema URL, for editor validation and completion.

title.description: Title of the system. Shown on views that do not set their own.

description.description: What the system is, in a sentence or a paragraph. With the title it is the heading block a picture carries when an export sets heading: true or render is given --heading.

direction.description: Default flow direction for views: connections run left-to-right ("right") or top-to-bottom ("down"). The only layout hint at this level; positions are computed automatically and are deterministic. Narrow, top-down diagrams read best on phones.

states.description: Your state vocabulary bound to how each state is drawn. Omit for the defaults: on (normal), degraded (warn), failed (alert, stops flow), off (muted, stops flow). Define an existing name to override it, a new name to extend, or set replace to start from nothing. Nothing reads a name; only look and flows matter.

default.description: State of any entity that declares none, and what 'restore' returns to.

replace.description: true: only the states in 'define' exist; 'default' must then name one of them.

oneOf.description: Pack names; later packs win over earlier ones.

use.description: A states vocabulary shipped with the tool, merged before 'define': sre (healthy, impaired, brownout, outage, drained).

oneOf.description: Preset: normal; warn (amber); alert (red, pulsing outline); muted (dimmed, dashed); highlight (blue glow).
Custom style. Only what you set changes; the rest stays normal.

pulse.description: Pulsing outline (animated; frame tooling freezes it).

look.description: Visual treatment: a preset name or a style object. Only what you set changes; the rest stays normal.

flows.description: 'stop': connections touching an entity in this state are drawn with no flow, whatever their load. A drawing rule, so a failed box is not shown receiving traffic.

description.description: What this state means to you. Shown in the legend.

kinds.description: Your kind vocabulary for components, groups and connections, bound to a glyph, a frame or a line style. Omit for the defaults. 'use' pulls in a pack shipped with the tool. Define an existing name to override it, a new name to extend, or set replace to start from nothing.

replace.description: true: only the kinds defined here exist.

oneOf.description: Pack names; later packs win over earlier ones.

use.description: Vocabulary packs shipped with the tool, merged before your own definitions: aws, azure, gcp (the providers' icons as kinds named aws:s3, gcp:cloud-run, azure:sql-database). `orrery packs <name>` lists a pack's kinds.

oneOf.description: A preset glyph name (database, queue, cache, gateway, client, storage, function) or SVG path data drawn with the theme's stroke in a 16×16 box.
An icon in its own colours: SVG markup drawn in the box's glyph slot. Packs use this form.

viewBox.description: The icon's coordinate box, four numbers like "0 0 64 64".

svg.description: The icon's SVG markup: shapes, gradients, groups. No script, foreignObject, image, style or event handlers.

glyph.description: How the kind is drawn inside its box: a preset name, path data, or an icon object.

shape.description: The outline, a name from 'shapes' (presets: box, sharp, pill, ellipse, cylinder, hexagon, diamond, parallelogram, document, card, cloud). Default box. The default kinds bind database to cylinder, queue to parallelogram, gateway to hexagon, client to pill, external to cloud.

description.description: What this kind means to you. Shown in the legend.

shape.description: The frame's outline, a name from 'shapes' (presets: box, sharp, pill, ellipse, cylinder, hexagon, diamond, parallelogram, document, card, cloud). Default box. Drawn open, around the members, and closed, at component size.

frame.description: A preset frame name or a style object.

description.description: What this kind means to you. Shown in the legend.

connections.description: Connection kinds by name. Defaults: sync (solid), async (dashed), replication (dotted), dataflow (heavy).

additionalProperties.description: How connections of this kind are drawn.

line.description: A preset line name (solid, dashed, dotted, heavy) or a style object. A new kind without one is solid.

oneOf.description: Line style. Only what you set changes; the rest stays the default.

dash.description: Dash pattern as an SVG stroke-dasharray, e.g. "6 5". Omit for a solid line.

flow.description: Colour of the animated traffic along the line. Default blue.

description.description: What this kind means to you.

shapes.description: Your shape vocabulary: component outlines by name. Omit for the presets: box (the default), sharp, pill, ellipse, cylinder, hexagon, diamond, parallelogram, document, card, cloud. Define an existing name to override it, a new name to extend, or set replace to start from nothing (then define box). A component or group kind names one with 'shape'.

replace.description: true: only the shapes in 'define' exist; 'box' must then be one of them.

path.description: SVG path data drawn in a 100×100 box and scaled to the component's size (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute or relative).

corner.description: A rounded rectangle with this corner radius in px, or 'round' for a pill.

pad.description: Room the label needs to clear the outline, in px on each side. Default 0.

description.description: What this shape means to you.

components.description: The running things: services, databases, queues, clients, external systems. A component is one deployment in one place; the same code in two regions is two components. Order matters: components that end up side by side keep this order, so list the important ones first.

id.description: Unique handle, shared id space with groups. Letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; starts with a letter or digit.

label.description: Display name. Defaults to the id.

kind.description: What the component is, from 'kinds' (defaults: service, database, queue, cache, gateway, client, storage, function, external). Picks the glyph and box style; no mechanics. 'client' covers people and devices; 'external' is a system outside your control.

group.description: Id of the group this component sits in. Omit for top level.

state.description: State in the base model, one of the names in 'states'. Defaults to states.default. Scenario steps and what-ifs change it.

replicas.description: How many instances run. Drawn as a stacked box with the count.

description.description: One or two sentences, shown as a tooltip.

meta.description: Free-form data ignored by rendering: owner, url, tags, cost centre. The only place for anything Orrery does not model.

connections.description: What one entity does to another: calls it, publishes to it, replicates to it, streams data to it. Either end may be a component or a group (even an empty one). Directed from the initiator ('from') to the target ('to'). Connections carry no health semantics; see 'needs' for that. Two connections between the same pair must both have ids.

from.description: Initiating entity id: a component or a group.

to.description: Target entity id: a component or a group. The arrowhead is drawn here; on a group it attaches to the frame.

id.description: Optional handle. Required when the same pair of entities has more than one connection, so scenarios can tell them apart.

kind.description: How it is drawn: a name from 'kinds.connections' (defaults: sync solid, async dashed, replication dotted, dataflow heavy).

label.description: Short text on the line: protocol or purpose.

load.description: Relative traffic, 0 to 1: speed and weight of the animated flow; 0 hides it. Not real units. Scenario steps change it.

bidirectional.description: Draw arrowheads at both ends. The flow still animates from 'from' to 'to'.

meta.description: Free-form data ignored by rendering: owner, url, tags, cost centre.

groups.description: Containers drawn as labelled frames: tiers, regions, zones, clusters, trust boundaries, or whole systems not opened yet. May be empty (a black box). Nest with 'parent'. Groups can be connected, needed and failed like components. The hierarchy is also the outline for navigation.

id.description: Unique handle, shared id space with components.

label.description: Frame title. Defaults to the id.

kind.description: What the container represents, from 'kinds' (defaults: tier, region, zone, cluster, boundary). Picks the frame style; no mechanics.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing group. Omit for top level. Cycles are rejected.

meta.description: Free-form data ignored by rendering: owner, url, tags, cost centre.

state.description: State of the group as an entity: how its frame is drawn. Says nothing about the members; set theirs too if they change. Defaults to states.default.

description.description: One or two sentences, shown as a tooltip.

views.description: Drawings of the model. Optional: without it, one topology view of everything is rendered. Pick one with `orrery render --view <id>`. Connections with one end outside a view are drawn to a ghost of the outside component, never dropped.

title.description: Title for this view. Defaults to the document title.

description.description: What this view shows. With the view's title it is the heading block for pictures of this view; wins over the model's description.

type.description: Kind of drawing. Only 'topology' exists today; 'sequence' and 'walkthrough' are reserved.

direction.description: Flow direction for this view. Defaults to the document direction.

scope.description: Group id to drill into: that group becomes the outer frame and only its descendants are shown.

only.description: Show only these entities (a group id means the group and everything in it) plus the groups containing them. Combines with 'scope' by intersection.

play.description: Play a scenario on a timer in this view. The rendered file carries every step as a layer and cycles them with CSS, so it animates inside an image tag with no script; the interactive runtime plays the same steps until the reader interacts.

scenario.description: Scenario id to play. The base model shows first, then each step in order, then it loops.

seconds.description: Seconds each step stays on screen.

collapse.description: Group ids drawn closed in this view: a closed group is one box the size of a component, its name centred with an expand mark, nothing inside, connections re-attached to it. Opening it (a scene's or export's 'open', a click in the interactive file, or a page's call) lays the view out again with the group open and moves the picture there. Closed groups nest to any depth; opening an inner one means opening the ones above it too.

scenarios.description: Named what-if stories in your words. Each step puts entities in states (with a reason if you like), restores them, or sets connection loads. Steps are cumulative.

label.description: Human title. Defaults to the id.

steps.description: Ordered changes. A step must change at least one thing and may name an entity only once across 'set' and 'restore'.

note.description: What happens in this step, shown during step-through.

set.description: State name to entities: an id, a list of ids, or an object of id to reason. "set": { "failed": "db", "degraded": { "api": "reads from the replica" } }. A reason is your one-line explanation, shown as a tooltip. Any name from 'states'.

additionalProperties.description: Why this entity is in this state here.

restore.description: Entity id(s) returned to their base-model state.

load.description: Connection loads at this step. Refer to a connection by its ends, or by 'id' when the pair has several. This is how traffic moves in a story.

from.description: Initiating entity id (with 'to'); a component or a group.

to.description: Target entity id (with 'from'); a component or a group.

tour.description: A story told over the model on a timer: scenes shown in turn, each the view at a moment of a scenario, optionally with the camera closed on a group. In the file this is CSS: one drawing, a camera track and level-of-detail tracks, so it plays inside an image tag; the interactive runtime plays the same scenes with its camera until the reader interacts.

seconds.description: Seconds a scene stays on screen unless it says otherwise.

views.description: Shorthand: these views in turn, each for 'seconds'.

view.description: View id shown in this scene.

scenario.description: Scenario applied in this scene, up to 'step' (default: all steps).

set.description: States for this scene, as in a scenario step: state name to an id, a list of ids, or an object of id to reason.

additionalProperties.description: Why this entity is in this state here.

note.description: Caption for the scene. Defaults to the view's title, plus the scenario step's note.

seconds.description: How long this scene stays. Defaults to the tour's seconds.

open.description: Closed groups drawn open, by id. Each must be in the view's 'collapse', and a group inside another closed group needs that one listed too: what is open is exactly what is written. Omit for everything closed.

zoom.description: The entity the camera closes on: a component, an open group's frame or a closed group's box, as long as it is not inside a closed group. Omit for the whole picture. Opening and zooming are separate: a scene can open two groups and stay zoomed out, or zoom in on one of them.

exports.description: The files this model produces, one picture or animation each, written by 'orrery export <file> --out <dir>' as <dir>/<id>.svg. Enclosed files: CSS animation only, no script, so each plays inside an image tag anywhere. Declared next to the views and scenarios they draw from, so the documentation's images are regenerated by the same build as the system.

items.description: One export: a view at a moment, a scenario playing, the inside of a group, or the tour.

id.description: File name without extension. Unique within exports.

view.description: View id to draw. Defaults to the first view.

scenario.description: Scenario applied, up to 'step' (default: all steps). Exclusive with 'play'.

set.description: A what-if for this export, as a scenario step's 'set': state name to an id, a list of ids, or an object of id to reason.

additionalProperties.description: Why this entity is in this state here.

play.description: Scenario id to play on a loop: the base model, then each step, cycled by CSS. Exclusive with 'scenario'.

seconds.description: Seconds each step stays on screen when 'play' is set. Default 3.

tour.description: true: the model's tour as one drawing that moves. Exclusive with every other field but 'id'.

open.description: Closed groups drawn open in this picture, by id: a still of the inside. Each must be in the view's 'collapse', and a group inside another closed group needs that one listed too.

zoom.description: The entity the picture is cropped to, with a little air around it: a component or a group not inside a closed group. Omit for the whole picture.

oneOf.description: Draw the heading with its text centred or at the left edge.

heading.description: Draw the title and description block above the picture (the view's own, else the model's): true for centred text, or 'centre' / 'left'. Allowed with tour.
